# Captured local property writer return slot

Original Java 8 anonymous class uses its enclosing Owner<K,V> formals in a
Map.Entry implementation. Corpus construction changes the UTF8 method name
assign to setValue and sets the anonymous class ACC_FINAL bit to model a closed
compiler output. Independent byte receipts prove every Code byte and all other
attributes remain unchanged.
The void writer and reference updater retain separate original bodies. The
observer checks source naming disclosures, all generated sources and mapped
metadata, previous value identity, callback mutation, exact errors, reflection,
method handles and frozen caller inputs. No external application data is used.
